categories.main_business_segments: Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the development, design, production, and sales of optical chips. Its main products include DFB and EML laser series chips with transmission rates ranging from 2.5G to 200G and higher, as well as high-power silicon photonic light source products. These products serve telecommunications markets (fiber access and mobile communication networks), data centers, and automotive LiDAR markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturing) mode covering chip design, wafer manufacturing, chip processing, and testing. Core technologies include MOCVD epitaxial growth, grating technology, optical waveguide fabrication, metallization, facet coating, automated chip testing, high-frequency testing, and reliability verification. Key proprietary technologies include buried heterostructure and ridge waveguide laser chip manufacturing platforms, high-speed modulation laser chips, heterojunction semiconductor material bonding, small divergence angle technology, anti-reflection technology, electro-absorption modulator integration, and high-power laser chip reliability techniques.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuanjie serves primarily telecommunications operators and equipment manufacturers in China and abroad, focusing on fiber access networks (EPON, GPON, 10G PON, 25G/50G PON), 4G/5G mobile communication networks, and data center customers requiring high-speed optical modules. The company also targets automotive LiDAR manufacturers and sensor markets. Its customer base includes major domestic telecom operators and international data center clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Shaanxi Province. It also has subsidiaries in Singapore and the United States to support overseas trade and manufacturing. Its sales and customer base extend to both domestic and international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanjie Semiconductor operates primarily upstream and midstream in the optical communication supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacturing of optical chips and laser components. It controls the full production process from epitaxial wafer growth to chip fabrication and testing, supplying downstream optical module manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to develop higher-speed, higher-power, and more integrated optical chips. Strategic priorities include advancing CW silicon photonic light sources, 100G/200G PAM4 EML laser chips, and high-power CW laser chips for data centers and AI applications. It also focuses on developing next-generation 25G/50G PON products, integrated semiconductor optical amplifiers, and exploring new application fields such as automotive LiDAR and sensing. Yuanjie aims to build a strong talent platform, enhance wafer process development, and deepen high-end equipment application and process technology.
categories.revenue_model: Yuanjie generates revenue primarily through direct sales of optical chips and laser components. It mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors. Revenue recognition occurs upon delivery and customer acceptance of products, with contracts specifying quality objection periods. The company also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanjie is positioned as a leading domestic optical chip supplier with a growing presence in both telecommunications and data center markets. It competes with international suppliers in high-speed and high-power laser chips, especially in the data center segment. The company differentiates itself through proprietary IDM manufacturing capabilities and a broad product portfolio covering multiple transmission rates and application scenarios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Yuanjie achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 252 million, a 74.63% increase year-over-year, driven by recovery in downstream demand and expansion into data center markets. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 6.13 million, declining 131.49% due to increased R&D expenses, asset impairment provisions, and pricing pressure in traditional telecom products. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.15 billion with a slight decrease compared to the previous year. R&D investment accounted for 21.62% of revenue, reflecting a strong growth and innovation focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanjie emphasizes its IDM full-process control, enabling rapid product development and high manufacturing autonomy. Its core technologies provide high reliability, small divergence angles, anti-reflection integration, and high-power output, which reduce downstream packaging costs and dependence on imported components. The company offers a diversified product portfolio tailored to various telecom and data center needs, with competitive performance and cost advantages. Its strategic focus on emerging markets like AI data centers and automotive LiDAR further differentiates its offerings.
